description: A middle-school principal must finalize a student's re-entry plan after a suspension, including daily supports and the required restorative conference, with input from the student's teacher and school counselor.
decisive_fact_themes: The teacher's observations change the plan from unspecified support to a 20-minute daily check-in for exactly 10 school days and a seat near the classroom exit.

The family's confirmed availability changes the conference from an unspecified or after-school appointment to Tuesday at 7:45 a.m. and requires a calendar entry citing the counselor's scheduling information.

description: A curriculum director must decide whether to authorize a proposed dual-credit environmental science course and finalize its staffing, credit value, laboratory contact hours, and compliance paperwork, with input from the science department chair and the college dual-enrollment liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The proposed instructor appears sufficient from the submitted course materials; PF1 changes staffing from no required co-teacher to a credentialed co-teacher assigned to every meeting and adds the credential-verification commitment.
The proposal states 2 credits and 1 laboratory hour; PF2 changes the course to exactly 3 credits and 2 laboratory contact hours per week and adds the articulation-compliance commitment.

description: An assistant principal must approve an after-school student culinary showcase and finalize the room, food-safety supervision, and allergy protections, with input from the culinary arts teacher and school nurse.
decisive_fact_themes: The room changes from the form's Kitchen 1 to Kitchen 2, and the food-service supervisor changes to Mr. Shah because Kitchen 2 alone has the inspected hood and handwashing station and Mr. Shah is the certified adult.
The health plan changes the menu to no peanuts or tree nuts, sets the exact number of epinephrine kits to two, requires a trained adult, and adds the allergy emergency-plan commitment.

description: A science department head must finalize four-day substitute coverage for an absent physics teacher during an active laboratory sequence, including the daily assignments and supervision documentation, with input from the lead physics teacher and the staffing coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The revised lesson sequence changes the apparatus-lab dates from an unspecified schedule to exactly Day 2 and Day 4, which determines the split coverage plan.
The authorization record changes the Day 2 and Day 4 assignment from Mr. Cole to Ms. Imani and requires a credential-verification commitment.

description: A principal must approve and configure a six-Saturday high-school credit-recovery program, including its delivery setting, enrollment cap, instructor, stipend, and funding documentation, with input from an instructional coach and the school's finance coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The confirmed attendance count changes the enrollment cap from the submitted 20 seats to exactly 14, and the students' required platform work changes the setting from a regular classroom to the computer lab.
The grant award changes staffing to a certified mathematics teacher, sets the stipend at exactly $400 per session, and changes the funding source to the credit-recovery grant.

description: A college registrar must decide whether to approve a student's late withdrawal petition for BIO 210 and finalize the effective date, financial adjustment, and record corrections, with input from the instructor, academic counselor, financial aid officer, and disability services coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The instructor's record changes the effective withdrawal date from an unspecified late date to exactly October 14, 2025.
The counselor's medical documentation changes the petition from a likely denial to an approved retroactive medical withdrawal and requires a medical-withdrawal documentation commitment.
The financial-aid confirmation changes the tuition adjustment from no defined credit to exactly a 50 percent tuition credit.
The accommodation log changes the record action from no correction to a required grade-record correction removing the BIO 210 midterm penalty.

description: A dean of undergraduate studies must finalize an academic recovery contract for a college student on academic probation, including the student's course plan, enrollment conditions, support commitments, and approval documentation, with input from an academic advisor, registrar, student counselor, and financial-aid specialist.
decisive_fact_themes: The degree-audit finding changes the required course from the draft elective to CHEM 201 and changes the required course value to exactly 4 credits.
The registrar's standing rule changes the enrollment condition from an unspecified full-time load to exactly 12 completed spring credits.
The counseling record changes the delivery plan by requiring at least 6 of the 12 credits to be asynchronous.
The aid-committee condition changes the support commitment to advisor meetings every two weeks for the first 8 weeks.

description: A district assessment director must certify the administration plan for an upcoming online state assessment, including devices, room configuration, proctoring, and health monitoring, with input from the school technology coordinator, facilities manager, school nurse, and testing coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The device choice changes from student-owned laptops to certified district-managed Chromebooks because the state ticket makes the latter mandatory for certification.
The room configuration changes from one library room to exactly two rooms, the library and Room 204, because the library's 18-student fire-safety limit is below the 27-student roster.
The health-monitoring plan changes from the standard procedure to a 10:00 a.m. nurse-supervised glucose check in an adjacent room followed by a return to testing.
The staffing count changes from two proctors to exactly three because the state rule requires one trained proctor for every 10 or fewer students and the roster has 27 students.

description: A college director of library services must authorize an eight-week extended-hours library pilot and finalize its operating schedule, staffing, access controls, and funding, with input from facilities, campus safety, information technology, and finance.
decisive_fact_themes: The Wednesday fire-alarm test changes the operating schedule from Monday through Friday to exactly Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
The after-10:00 p.m. safety rule changes staffing from the proposal's one employee to exactly two authorized adults and requires a two-person coverage commitment.
The access-control limitation changes entry from ordinary student-ID access to currently enrolled students using college ID cards only.
The executed grant award changes the funding decision to exactly $3,200 from the library innovation grant and permits that amount to cover two-person evening staffing.

description: A director of student services must approve a proposed middle-school peer-tutoring program and finalize its supervision, digital platform, student matching, and consent procedures, with input from the tutoring teacher, school counselor, technology coordinator, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The finalized roster of 18 tutors changes the required supervision level from the draft's two adults to exactly three adults under the six-tutors-per-adult rule.
The two active no-contact restrictions change pairings from student-selected matches to counselor assignment and require a recorded no-contact safeguard.
The district platform confirmation changes the communication platform from Google Classroom to approved Microsoft Teams.
The family-engagement procedure changes consent from paper collection alone to an SIS entry required before participation.

description: A director of career and technical education must authorize the conversion of Lab 3 into a robotics laboratory and finalize its capacity, electrical preparation, network configuration, and funding documentation, with input from the robotics teacher, facilities manager, information technology coordinator, and finance officer.
decision_maker_role: Director of Career and Technical Education
decisive_fact_themes: The confirmed roster changes the approved workstation count from the draft 12 to exactly 16.
The inspection changes the infrastructure decision from using the existing circuit to installing a dedicated 240-volt circuit and documenting that upgrade.
The vendor specification changes the network choice from unspecified or ordinary Wi-Fi to the district-secure IoT network with wired drops and requires an installation commitment.
The executed award changes the funding entry to exactly $18,500 from the workforce-development grant and requires the amount to be recorded in the project ledger.

description: A chief academic officer must approve the district's proposed eighth-grade mathematics materials and finalize the implementation requirements, accessibility provisions, and funding record, with input from curriculum, library, multilingual-learning, and finance staff.
decisive_fact_themes: The pilot finding changes the intervention allocation from the draft 60 minutes per week to exactly 90 minutes per week.
The license review changes the approval record by requiring a licensing-attribution commitment containing the exact statement "Adapted from OpenMath Core."
The family review changes the materials specification from no listed multilingual supplement to inclusion of a Spanish-English glossary for the 22 identified students.
The executed award changes the funding record to the instructional-materials grant and the exact amount of $6,800.

description: A director of experiential learning must approve a student's summer internship at an elementary learning center and finalize its academic-credit, training, funding, and start requirements, with input from an academic advisor, an employer liaison, and a financial-aid specialist.
decisive_fact_themes: The degree audit changes the internship registration from the draft's 1 credit to exactly 3 credits.
The host handbook changes the plan from no listed training condition to mandated-reporter training completed before child contact, with an employer-training verification commitment.
The aid award record changes the registration deadline to May 15, changes grant status to retained, forbids accepting a stipend, and requires a financial-aid compliance commitment.

description: A college dean of students must finalize a student's re-entry plan after a residence-hall vandalism case, including the sanction, restitution, housing assignment, conduct-meeting format, and counseling support, with input from conduct, residence-life, and counseling staff.
decisive_fact_themes: The first-violation finding changes the sanction from a 10-day suspension to a restorative agreement and changes restitution from $500 to exactly $250.
The active no-contact directive and confirmed vacancy change the housing assignment to exactly Oak Hall room 318 and require a recorded no-contact safeguard.
The documented accommodation changes conduct check-ins from in person to secure video and sets counseling at exactly two appointments per week for the first four weeks.

description: A middle-school counselor must finalize a student's ten-day return-to-school support plan after a prolonged absence, including the daily attendance schedule, physical-education status, academic catch-up load, independent-work window, transportation stop, and implementation record, with input from the student's teacher, school nurse, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The teacher's review changes the catch-up load to exactly two assignments per day and changes the subject order to mathematics and science first.
The physician clearance changes the attendance plan to 8:30 a.m. through 12:00 p.m. in person and changes physical-education status to excused for the first ten school days.
The caregiver confirmation changes the independent-work window to 3:00 p.m. through 4:00 p.m. and changes the transportation assignment to the Oak Street bus stop.

description: A college curriculum director must authorize a new dual-credit environmental science course for a partner high school and finalize its enrollment limit, course code, credit value, instructor assignment, and transcript documentation, with input from the proposed teacher, the high-school registrar, and the community-college liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The room inspection changes the allowable enrollment from the draft 28 students to exactly 20 students.
The transcript crosswalk changes the course code to exactly ENV-115, changes the credit value to exactly 4, and requires a matching transcript commitment.
The articulation memorandum changes the instructor for the first six weeks from Ms. Patel to Dr. Lewis and requires an instructor-verification commitment.

description: An assistant principal must finalize a five-day coverage plan for an absent chemistry teacher, including who covers each class period, whether scheduled laboratory practicals proceed, and when senior students complete a required makeup session, with input from the chemistry department chair, the human-resources certification officer, and the school counselor.
decisive_fact_themes: The department calendar changes the laboratory decision from postponement to conducting the Tuesday and Thursday practicals with Nguyen and requires a recorded safety-supervision commitment.
The contract limits change the coverage assignment from Hall covering all periods to the exact split of Hall for periods 1-3 and Nguyen for periods 4-5.

The graduation audit and family transportation confirmation change the plan from postponing the seniors' practical to a Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m. makeup session and require a student-support calendar entry.

description: An assistant principal must finalize a six-week cell-phone policy pilot for the high school, including its grade scope, storage procedure, safety-plan exception, launch date, and implementation records, with input from a ninth-grade teacher, a school counselor, and the technology coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The teacher's 9th-grade trial changes the pilot scope from grades 9 and 10 to grade 9 only and changes storage from open bins to one numbered locking pouch per student.
The two active safety plans change the procedure from no listed exception to allowing students with those plans to retain access for time-sensitive caregiver messages.
The confirmed systems deployment changes the launch date from September 2, 2026, to September 16, 2026, and requires a digital registration record.

description: A principal must decide whether to authorize converting an unused courtyard into a science learning garden and finalize the site's preparation, plant design, instructional use, and maintenance plan, with input from the facilities manager and the science teacher.
decisive_fact_themes: The soil report changes preparation from planting in existing soil to removing exactly 8 inches and replacing it with certified clean soil, and it creates the need for a formal soil-remediation record.

The executed grant changes the design to exactly 10 native species, changes instruction to exactly 6 garden lessons completed by November 1, 2026, changes maintenance to Tuesdays and Thursdays at 2:30 p.m., and requires a grant-compliance record.

description: A principal must approve the publication plan for a student newspaper investigation and finalize its attribution, distribution channel, image use, and records access, with input from the journalism adviser and the library media specialist.
decisive_fact_themes: The source's explicit request changes the byline from the named attribution in the draft to exactly "River" and requires a source-protection record.

The license terms change distribution from print plus public website to print only, remove the photograph from the website, restrict the archive to internal access, and require an image-license record.

description: A principal must approve the plan for the school's annual emergency evacuation exercise and finalize its format, assembly area, medical support, student alternatives, and family notification procedures, with input from the school nurse, school counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The seizure action plan changes the medical provisions from no designated station or assigned medical escort to both a medical-support station and a nurse-or-backup assignment.
The trauma accommodations change the exercise format from a standard surprise alarm to an announced walkthrough and add a supervised opt-out location.
The resurfacing closure and fire-marshal confirmation change the assembly area from the east courtyard to the west field and require an assembly-area confirmation commitment.
The district notification procedure changes the family notice to exactly 72 hours in advance and requires Spanish, Somali, and Vietnamese versions plus a multilingual-notification commitment.

description: A college library director must finalize the access plan for a high-enrollment course's required reading packet, including digital access, print reserves, accessible format, licensing, and readiness timing, with input from the instructor, copyright librarian, accessibility coordinator, and bookstore manager.
decisive_fact_themes: The enrollment of 48 students, combined with the 25-user digital limit, changes the required print reserve quantity to exactly 23 copies.
The publisher's license changes the digital capacity from the draft 40 users to exactly 25 and requires a license record.
The approved screen-reader requirement changes the accessible format from scanned PDF to tagged HTML and requires an accessibility-format commitment.
The vendor confirmation changes the readiness timing to exactly seven days before the course begins.

description: A director of nursing education must approve the final administration plan for a medication-safety simulation assessment, including evaluator qualifications, station rotations, assessment date, and results deadline, with input from the clinical coordinator, simulation-lab manager, registrar, and student-services coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The evaluator changes from the draft's unspecified faculty evaluator to a current, unencumbered registered nurse, and that exact qualification requires a state-compliance verification commitment.
The three calibrated pumps and three-student safety limit change the draft from two rotations of six to exactly four rotations of three and require an equipment-rotation commitment.
The accreditation calendar changes the results-entry date from June 21, 2027 to exactly June 14, 2027 and requires an accreditation-deadline commitment.
The approved observance absences and confirmed alternative change the assessment date from May 8, 2027 to exactly May 10, 2027 and require a student-observance accommodation commitment.

description: A director of career and technical education must authorize the reopening of a metal-fabrication lab and finalize its enrollment, respiratory protection, fire-watch procedure, and instructional staffing plan, with input from the lab instructor, district safety officer, school nurse, and industry-partnership coordinator.
decision_maker_role: Director of Career and Technical Education
decisive_fact_themes: The airflow test changes the enrollment cap from the draft 20 students to exactly 12 students.
The fire-code review changes the procedure from ordinary cleanup to a permit for every session and an exact 30-minute fire watch, requiring a safety-compliance record.
The two students' health plans change respiratory protection from standard equipment to powered air-purifying respirators.
The insurer's credential condition changes the lead instructor from Ms. Ortiz to Mr. Bell and changes the operating days to Tuesday/Thursday.

description: A district assessment director must approve the administration plan for a middle-school mathematics assessment, including testing mode, room assignments, proctoring, calculator rules, and test-material storage, with input from the school testing coordinator, mathematics instructional coach, technology manager, and assessment security officer.
decisive_fact_themes: The roster and 14-student room limit change the plan from one room of 26 with one proctor to rooms of 14 and 12 with two proctors.
The state manual changes calculator access from graphing calculators throughout the assessment to four-function calculators during section 2 only.
The device test and vendor confirmation change the testing mode from digital tablets to authorized paper booklets.
The security agreement changes storage from the general records cabinet to tamper-evident envelopes in a locked cabinet for exactly 30 calendar days.

description: A principal must approve a purchase and implementation plan for indoor-air-quality monitors in the science wing, including the number of monitors, installation scope, funding source, alert threshold, and health-review procedure, with input from facilities, the business office, and the school nurse.
decisive_fact_themes: The facilities inspection changes the required system from six monitors to exactly nine and changes the installation scope to all nine science-wing classrooms.
The ledger review changes the approved purchase total to exactly $4,320 and changes the funding source to the restricted capital account without a general-fund transfer.
The health-plan review changes the alert threshold to exactly 1,000 ppm and adds weekly nurse review during the first quarter.

description: A dean of students must finalize a student's return-to-school behavior plan after a cafeteria altercation, including supervision, check-ins, extracurricular eligibility, and family communication, with input from the student's teacher, school counselor, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The teacher's observation changes lunch supervision to an assigned-adult table and changes the check-in requirement to 30 minutes for exactly five school days.
The signed agreement changes extracurricular eligibility from unrestricted return to return only after one restorative conference.
The caregiver confirmation changes the meeting format to phone and changes the written notice language to Spanish.

description: A principal must approve and finalize an eighth-grade makerspace program, including enrollment, supervision, materials, and digital-design procedures, with input from the STEM teacher, school nurse, and technology coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The room-safety review changes enrollment from the draft 24 students to exactly 16 and changes soldering supervision from one adult to two adults.
The student's documented nickel allergy changes the materials policy to nickel-free components and adds a nurse approval before each session.
The district technology confirmation changes file handling from cloud storage to offline encrypted-USB transfer and adds an IT malware scan.

description: A district curriculum director must approve and specify a six-week classroom pilot of an adaptive writing platform, including its student scope, operating mode, data retention, teacher support, and family orientation plan, with input from an instructional coach, a data privacy officer, and an English-learner coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The classroom observation changes the participating grade to grade 7, sets the pilot length to exactly 6 weeks, and requires weekly teacher-planning coaching.
The final vendor agreement changes the data mode to local-only, sets identifiable-data retention to exactly 30 days, and requires a privacy-compliance review.
The family-access review changes the orientation language set to exactly English, Spanish, and Somali and requires a multilingual orientation.

description: A principal must approve a revised middle-school bell schedule and finalize its start time, dismissal time, lunch length, and implementation records, with input from the transportation coordinator and the staff-labor liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The revised bus confirmation changes the start from 8:00 a.m. to exactly 8:20 a.m. and the dismissal from 2:45 p.m. to exactly 3:05 p.m., and it requires a transportation confirmation commitment.

The ratified staff agreement changes lunch from 25 minutes to exactly 30 minutes, requires a labor-agreement compliance commitment, and supplies the private fact that must be cited in the justification.

description: A community college curriculum director must decide whether to approve a student's prior-learning credit petition and finalize the credit amount, assessment method, course equivalency, and transcript notation, with input from a biology faculty assessor and the registrar.
decisive_fact_themes: The faculty assessment changes the credit amount to exactly 6 and requires an observed practical in addition to the portfolio.
The articulation record changes the posting from a general elective or letter grade to BIO-115 equivalency with a CR notation.

description: An assistant principal must approve the operating design for a six-week peer-tutoring pilot, including session structure, student safeguards, record handling, and implementation procedures, with input from a literacy coach and a student-services coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The observation memo changes the draft ratio from four students per tutor to exactly two and changes the session length from 30 minutes to exactly 20.

The compliance review changes participation to signed-guardian-consent-only, changes the room condition to a visible adult-staffed room, changes retention to exactly 90 days, and requires the two safeguard records plus citation of PF2.

description: A director of work-based learning must authorize a student's community-garden internship and finalize the student's tasks, attendance schedule, health safeguards, group size, and on-site supervision.
decisive_fact_themes: The observed vocational assessment changes the assignment from general grounds work to seed sorting and labeling only and requires a task-restriction commitment.
The caregiver's confirmed availability changes the attendance days from Monday/Wednesday to Tuesday/Thursday and requires a schedule-confirmation commitment.
The health plan changes the glucose-check interval to no more than 60 minutes, requires a trained diabetes-response adult, and requires a health-protocol commitment.
The signed host agreement changes the work group to exactly two students, replaces the draft supervisor with Jordan Lee, and requires a host-agreement record.

description: A district curriculum director must authorize a student oral-history project and finalize its participant scope, supervision, recording safeguards, public-exhibit rules, and family consent process, with input from a classroom teacher, privacy officer, librarian, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The teacher's pilot changes the participant scope from grades 7 and 8 to grade 8 only and changes supervision from one adult to exactly two adults per session.

The privacy review changes storage to the district encrypted internal server, retention to exactly 45 days, and recording access to signed guardian consent, while requiring a privacy implementation commitment.
The rights review changes the public exhibit rule to a maximum excerpt of exactly 3 minutes and requires contributor attribution for every excerpt.
Family outreach changes the consent materials to exactly English, Spanish, and Arabic and adds paper consent availability plus a family-consent access commitment.

description: A dean of student success must approve an academic reinstatement plan for a student returning after a leave, including the term credit load, required-course sequence, disability accommodations, and financial-aid condition, with input from an academic advisor, registrar, disability-services coordinator, and financial-aid counselor.
decisive_fact_themes: The confirmed employment schedule changes the fall credit load from the draft's 12 credits to exactly 9 credits.
The registrar's course inventory changes STAT-210 from a fall daytime placement to an online summer placement and requires a course-sequence record.
The completed disability review changes the plan from no listed accommodation to exactly 1.5-times testing time with a reduced-distraction setting and requires an accommodation record.
The financial-aid confirmation changes the plan from no aid condition to a contract due exactly August 15 and requires a financial-aid condition record.

description: A director of student activities must approve the operating plan for a high-school spring musical and finalize the performance format, audience capacity, licensing, health safeguards, and transportation arrangements, with input from the drama teacher, facilities manager, school nurse, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The rights-holder confirmation changes the plan from ordinary performance with optional recording to a purchased live-performance license and a recording prohibition.
The facilities inspection changes the audience limit from the draft 220 seats to exactly 160 and requires a formal commitment that both side exits remain clear.
The health record changes the materials rule to latex-free and adds the concrete requirement that trained emergency-allergy staff be present at every performance.
The transportation confirmation changes the performance from the draft Friday evening event to a Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee and requires a transportation record.

description: An assistant principal must finalize a three-day coverage and instructional plan for an absent Advanced Chemistry teacher, including the substitute assignment, classroom activity, health staffing, and make-up materials, with input from the science department chair, human-resources coordinator, school nurse, and school counselor.
decisive_fact_themes: The calendar confirmation changes the second-day activity from ordinary work to a supervised graded chemistry lab practical and supplies the fact that must be cited in the justification.
The credential and availability verification changes the substitute assignment to Dr. Lena Park for all three days and changes the certification field to true.
The health-plan and training records change the required laboratory adult to Dr. Lena Park and add a health-response protocol commitment.
The confirmed caregiving circumstance changes the make-up format from the standard online process to a printed packet and adds a printed-packet preparation commitment.

description: A dean of academic affairs must approve the operating details of a new senior community-partnership capstone course, including its credit value, assessment method, transcript coding, meeting schedule, placement length, and enrollment limit, with input from a faculty sponsor, the registrar, and the career-learning coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The pilot's verified 60-hour requirement changes the course from one credit to two, and its documented assessment changes from a final essay to a faculty-reviewed portfolio.
The state inventory review changes the catalog code to BUS-198 and changes the transcript notation from a letter grade to S/U.
The partner confirmations change the placement schedule to Monday/Wednesday from 3:00-5:00 p.m. for six weeks and set the enrollment cap at exactly 12 students.

description: A principal must rule on a parent appeal concerning a challenged library book and finalize its access conditions, student guidance, and family-notice process, with input from the school librarian, school psychologist, and district compliance coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The curriculum map changes the ruling from possible removal to retaining the book because it is the designated core text for grade 10.
The student-support review changes access from ordinary checkout to a content advisory plus staff-mediated checkout and requires the access-guidance commitment.
The district rule changes the family process to parent opt-out, sets written notice at exactly 10 calendar days, and requires the family-notice commitment.

description: A dean of students must approve a student's return-to-school behavior and safety plan after a short suspension, including lunch supervision, daily check-ins, emergency response, and a family conference, with input from the student's teacher, school counselor, and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The cafeteria-transition observation changes lunch from ordinary cafeteria lunch to a supervised quiet setting for exactly 10 school days and creates the lunch-supervision commitment.
The active safety plan changes the check-in from weekly to 10 minutes every school day and changes the emergency response requirement to a trained adult within exactly 5 minutes.
The family's confirmed arrangement changes the conference from in-person to virtual on Wednesday at 4:00 p.m., adds an Arabic interpreter, and creates the family-conference access commitment.

description: An assistant principal must approve the operating plan for a new school food pantry, including storage controls, allergy labeling, pickup access, and family materials, with input from the school nurse and family liaison.
decisive_fact_themes: The health guidance changes the maximum refrigerated temperature to exactly 41 degrees, the logging interval to exactly 2 hours, allergen labeling from the standard procedure to required sealed-package labels, and adds the food-safety implementation commitment.

The family outreach changes pickup from Wednesday lunch to exactly Thursday 5:00-7:00 p.m., expands intake materials to exactly English, Spanish, and Somali, adds the family-access implementation commitment, and supplies the private fact that must be cited.

description: A district assessment director must approve the administration plan for a student's upcoming state science assessment, including testing environment, access tools, language support, and documentation, with input from a school psychologist and an English-language-development coordinator.
decisive_fact_themes: The approved evaluation changes the environment from the ordinary testing room to a small group capped at 5 and changes computer access from standard settings to text-to-speech for written directions.
The state guidance changes language support from no aid to a bilingual glossary while specifically prohibiting translation of test questions and answer choices.

description: A principal must decide whether a student may represent the school at a regional robotics competition after an academic-integrity referral and must finalize the student's team role, corrective work, and family conference arrangements, with input from the robotics coach and school counselor.
decisive_fact_themes: The first-minor-violation rubric finding changes the outcome from an unspecified or exclusionary response to eligibility with the exact documentation-auditor role, exactly 2 workshop hours, and a required recorded corrective assignment.

The family's confirmed arrangement changes the conference from an unspecified meeting to a virtual Tuesday meeting at exactly 6:00 p.m. with a Spanish interpreter and requires a family-conference commitment.

description: A curriculum director must approve the operating details of a new interdisciplinary college course, including its delivery format, instructional hours, assessment, course coding, and learning-material access, with input from the faculty sponsor, registrar, and copyright librarian.
decisive_fact_themes: The pilot report changes fieldwork from the draft's unspecified amount to exactly 20 hours and changes assessment from a final examination to a faculty-reviewed portfolio.
The transfer-articulation record changes the instructional requirement from 30 to exactly 45 contact hours and changes the catalog code from INT-200 to INT-205.
The publisher license changes materials access from public posting to enrolled-student password-protected e-reserve and requires a copyright-compliant implementation record.

description: A director of undergraduate research must authorize a student-led survey of first-year students and finalize the survey's collection settings, consent process, data retention, enrollment scope, and presentation rules, with input from the research coordinator, institutional privacy officer, and faculty mentor.
decisive_fact_themes: The platform test confirms that email collection is active and that test responses exist, changing the launch setting to disabled, the cleanup decision to true, and the required cleanup commitment.
The privacy classification changes the plan from anonymous ordinary handling to written consent, encrypted institutional storage, and deletion exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The course conditions change the respondent limit to exactly 100, restrict dissemination to the closed university undergraduate symposium, and require a course-condition implementation commitment.

description: A director of continuing education must approve the room, schedule, seating limit, and access setup for a Saturday make-up examination at a community college, with input from the registrar, accessibility services coordinator, and facilities manager.
decisive_fact_themes: The confirmed calendar changes the examination date to 2026-02-14 and the start time to 09:30 instead of leaving the session on an unconfirmed generic Saturday schedule.
The approved access plan changes the student's examination time to exactly 135 minutes, requires a screen-reader workstation, and creates the accessibility implementation commitment.
The inspection changes the usable North Hall occupancy to exactly 18 and requires North Hall selection plus an occupancy-and-unlock commitment for Saturday use.

description: A dean of students must approve an emergency residence-hall relocation and support plan for a college student after a serious roommate conflict, with input from the residence life coordinator and counseling center director.
decisive_fact_themes: The verified Cedar closure changes the relocation hall to Oak Hall, sets the move for Sunday at 4:00 p.m., fixes the temporary license at exactly 14 days, and supplies the facts required for the housing-relocation authorization.

The completed threat assessment changes the contact boundary to no contact through May 15, 2026, sets counseling at exactly one check-in per week, and requires the safety-follow-up commitment and explicit citation.

description: A dean of academic affairs must decide whether to approve a limited pilot of an AI writing-feedback platform in first-year composition and finalize its instructional and data-handling conditions, with input from the writing program director and institutional privacy officer.
decisive_fact_themes: The program standard changes the pilot from unspecified platform use to formative-only feedback, prohibits automated grading, requires instructor review before release, and requires an instructional-control commitment.
The privacy review changes the data condition to institutional single sign-on with zero vendor retention and requires a signed privacy addendum.

description: A college registrar must finalize a transcript correction for a graduating student whose biology course is marked NR, with input from the biology department chair and the financial aid officer.
decisive_fact_themes: The signed grade roster changes the record action from leaving the NR unresolved to replacing it with B+ for BIO-221 section 03 in Spring 2026.
The aid certification record changes the course status to attempted_and_earned and sets the certified enrollment total to exactly 12 credits.

description: A director of student activities must approve the operating plan for a Saturday student makerspace showcase, including the room, active equipment limit, supervision, and health safeguards, with input from the technology teacher and school nurse.
decisive_fact_themes: The electrical-load inspection changes the active-station limit from the proposed eight to exactly four, and the certification finding changes supervision from ordinary faculty coverage to a certified teacher physically present for laser use.
The reviewed health plans change the room from the proposed Room A to Room B, require its outdoor-air monitor, require immediately available rescue inhalers, and add the health-readiness commitment.

description: A director of student services must finalize one-day substitute coverage for three seventh-grade classrooms while their regular teachers attend district training, including the substitute assignment and required operating commitments, with input from a grade-level lead teacher, the human-resources staffing coordinator, and the school nurse.
